---
title: "ANOVA test for ooid loss vs microbial mat type"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ez)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}

# Read the Excel file
df_feb <- read_excel("ooid_data_master.xlsx", sheet = "field_feb_23")
df_may <- read_excel("ooid_data_master.xlsx", sheet = "field_may_23")
df_jul <- read_excel("ooid_data_master.xlsx", sheet = "field_july_23")
```



```{r}  
# Two-way ANOVA with interaction between the mat type (sample), and the hours after sediment delivery
anova_feb<-aov(`ooid` ~ `sample` * `hours after`, data = df_feb)
anova_may<-aov(`ooid` ~ `sample` * `hours after`, data = df_may)
anova_jul<-aov(`ooid` ~ `sample` * `hours after`, data = df_jul)

#display summary of results 
anova(anova_feb)
anova(anova_may)
anova(anova_jul)

```
